title: Health Charted Family History
description: The subject's family health history — about relatives, as it bears on the subject's hereditary risk. One entry per relative. Distinct from the subject's own profile; informs screening and risk reasoning.

relationship.description: Relationship to the subject (e.g., 'mother', 'paternal grandfather', 'maternal aunt', 'sibling').

age.description: Current age, or age at death if deceased.

conditions.description: Conditions this relative has/had, relevant to the subject's risk.

slug.description: Condition concept slug (same namespace as health-profile.conditions[].slug), so 'this relative had X' links to the X concept whether or not the subject has it.

age_of_onset.description: Age or approximate age the relative developed it (a key hereditary-risk signal).
